question: Within what vast multitude of womb-mechanisms are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The number involved is eighty-four thousand.
These are womb-mechanisms or sources of birth.
inference: Beings suffer affliction across an immense array of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the tormented beings is implied from context rather than stated in this verse.
plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
